# Vetta 0.6.27
<!-- release-status: unreleased -->

## English

### New

- Magpie now connects from Magpie: with the official magpie-vetta plugin, switch Vetta on in Magpie's Agents page and its models, routing groups included, appear in Vetta's model picker; switch it off to remove them.
- Kimi now has two presets, Kimi (Global) and Kimi (China), so keys from either Moonshot platform work.

### Improvements

- Settings shows whether Magpie is connected, with a How to connect guide, and model changes Magpie or you make to the model config outside Vetta show up without a restart.

### Fixes

- Error toasts, such as a failed key check, now show above an open dialog instead of behind it.
- Changing the key of a preset provider no longer drops request headers you added yourself.

### Upgrade notes

- If you enabled Magpie in Vetta's settings before, it is removed on first launch and a guide shows the new way: install magpie-vetta in Magpie, then switch Vetta on in its Agents page. Re-pick your default model if it was a Magpie model.

## 中文

### 新增

- Magpie 改为在 Magpie 里接入：装上官方插件 magpie-vetta，在 Agents 页打开 Vetta，模型（含路由组）即出现在模型选择器里，关掉即移除。
- Kimi 分为 Kimi (Global) 与 Kimi (China) 两个预设，国内站的 Key 也能直接接入。

### 改进

- 设置里可看到 Magpie 是否已接入并打开接入说明；Magpie 或你在 Vetta 之外改动的模型配置，无需重启即可生效。

### 修复

- 报错提示（如 Key 校验失败）现在显示在打开的弹窗之上，不再被遮住。
- 给预设服务商换 Key 后，自己加的请求头不再丢失。

### 升级注意

- 设置里启用过的 Magpie 首次启动时会移除并提示：在 Magpie 装 magpie-vetta，到 Agents 页打开 Vetta；默认模型若是 Magpie 的需重选。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.26...v0.6.27
